description: This source file defines the abstract class `_LoadBalancer` and multiple load balancing strategies related to tensor sharding in PyTorch distributed context, specifically for attention mechanisms in model parallelism. It includes classes for head-tail load balancing, document-level load balancing, and processing-time-based round robin load balancing, with detailed docstrings explaining their purpose and usage.

classes.name: _LoadBalancer
classes.description: An abstract base class defining the interface for load balancing strategies in tensor sharding for attention.

classes.name: _HeadTailLoadBalancer
classes.description: Implements head-tail pattern for load balancing by rearranging sequence indices to balance computation load across devices.

classes.name: _PerDocumentHeadTailLoadBalancer
classes.description: Implements per-document head-tail load balancing, applying head-tail reordering within each document for balanced attention computation.

classes.name: _PTRRLoadBalancer
classes.description: Performs Processing-Time based Round Robin load balancing, suitable for flex_attention, with block mask integration.

methods.name: Tensor _generate_indices_for_batch(self, seq_length_per_doc, restore)
methods.description: Generates load balancing indices for a batch of sequences in per-document head-tail balancing.

methods.description: Static method to partition tasks into groups based on process time for PTRR scheduling.
